title: Intro to RAG
text: Retrieval augmented generation combines a retriever with a language model. The retriever fetches relevant documents from a corpus and the generator conditions its answer on those documents.

title: Vector Databases
text: Vector databases like FAISS, Pinecone, and Qdrant store dense embeddings and support approximate nearest neighbor search for semantic retrieval at scale.

title: BM25 Ranking
text: BM25 is a sparse lexical ranking function based on term frequency and inverse document frequency, widely used as a strong retrieval baseline.

title: Precision and Recall
text: Precision measures the fraction of retrieved documents that are relevant. Recall measures the fraction of relevant documents that were retrieved.

title: Mean Reciprocal Rank
text: Mean reciprocal rank scores a ranked list by the inverse of the position of the first relevant result, averaged across queries.

title: Chunking Strategies
text: Document chunking splits long text into smaller passages before embedding, balancing context length against retrieval granularity.

title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
text: Multi-agent systems coordinate specialized agents such as planners, retrievers, and writers using frameworks like LangGraph or CrewAI.

title: Model Context Protocol
text: MCP is an open protocol that lets language model applications connect to external tools and data sources through a standardized interface.

title: Cross-Encoder Reranking
text: Cross-encoder rerankers jointly encode a query and candidate document to produce a more accurate relevance score than bi-encoder retrieval alone.

title: Embedding Models
text: Embedding models map text into dense vectors such that semantically similar texts end up close together in vector space.

title: Hybrid Search
text: Hybrid search combines sparse lexical signals like BM25 with dense vector similarity to improve retrieval robustness across query types.

title: Evaluation Datasets
text: A labeled query set, sometimes called qrels, pairs queries with the document ids judged relevant, enabling offline retrieval evaluation.

title: Guardrails for LLM Apps
text: Guardrails validate and filter model inputs and outputs, catching PII leakage, unsafe content, and out-of-scope requests before they reach users.

title: FastAPI Basics
text: FastAPI is a Python web framework for building APIs with automatic validation and interactive documentation based on type hints.

title: Prompt Engineering
text: Prompt engineering is the practice of designing inputs to a language model to reliably elicit a desired behavior or output format.
